final_message:
Blog slugs now keep the base letter of accented characters, so "Crème brûlée recipes" becomes `creme-brulee-recipes`. `npm test` passes, all 3 tests.

The cause is the vendored `slugify` 1.2.0, which drops any character outside `a-z0-9`, accented letters included. Its changelog says 1.2.1 fixes this, but the file is marked "do not edit by hand". Instead of editing it, I changed `src/blog/slug.js` to strip accents (Unicode NFD normalization, then removing the combining marks) before calling it.

If you'd rather fix it at the source, upgrade the vendored folder to 1.2.1 as `vendor/README.md` describes. You could then drop the extra line in `slug.js`. I didn't do that because it needs the upstream package, and it would also change slugs from `src/shop/product-url.js`, which uses the same vendored code.
